name: 04-sign-off-enabled
description: create-task with `sign-off.enabled: true`. The task's `sign_off_roles` frontmatter ([CTO, Tech Lead, Design (optional)]) overrides the project roster ([Tech Lead]) — per-document wins. The section must be UNNUMBERED (the 11-section contract is unchanged), every Signature and Date cell must be EMPTY, and the optional row must not count toward the required total.
prompt: Create a task for audit log retention. Architectural source: docs/architecture/tech-stack.md#storage and docs/architecture/coding-standards.md#naming.
